_comment: Registry of payments' OWN feature switches. Consumed by the Python backend (dbcore/feature_flags.py) and the Qwik frontend (apps/web/src/lib/features.ts). Source of truth in production is PostHog; the PostHog flag key is POSTHOG_FLAG_PREFIX + key (default prefix 'payments-', one PostHog project is shared with the other 3m4 apps). `default` is the fail-safe used when PostHog is unreachable or the flag is undefined there; self-host (no POSTHOG_API_KEY) enables everything unless a flag sets `self_host` explicitly.

site-building.description: Site-wide building curtain. ON = the hosted pages show the building page. The API, /badge/* and pay.js are unaffected. Inverse polarity: OFF is normal operation.

donations.description: Donation checkout (POST /api/checkout kind=donation, /donate page, pay.js donate buttons). OFF by default everywhere: enable it in PostHog per user (distinct_id = the accounts `sub`) or for everyone when the rollout is public. Guests evaluate as `anonymous`. The Stripe webhook is NEVER gated.

subscriptions.description: Subscription checkout and the Customer Portal (/subscribe, POST /api/portal). OFF by default everywhere: enable per user in PostHog (distinct_id = `sub`). Entitlement reads and webhooks are NEVER gated.

badges.description: Supporter badges (/badge/*) and the embed snippets on /me. OFF serves the grey 'not a supporter' badge for everyone.

fee-hint.description: Show '≈ X reaches Enrique after fees' on the donate page (GET /api/fees).
